liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Matty Groves**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Country Blues**: rare: 10 archived performances [7]
- **Guitar Peace**: back after 111 archived shows (843 days) [7]
- **Stratosphere**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **I Believe In You**: rare: 8 archived performances [7]
- **The Beginning Of The End**: rare: 13 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyStringsMVP2025** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 155 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillySMVPAlbanyNY2025**: audience recording; 26 songs; 154 min [2]. Said about its sound: The deck's right channel dropped out once during recording, so the taper adjusted levels; the deck is going back for service [2]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyMVPAlbany2025**: audience recording; 26 songs; 154 min [3]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyMVP2025**: audience recording; 26 songs; 154 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyStringsMVP2025**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Schoeps CCM 41V's & CCM41's Mix > Lemo Cables > MixPre 6 > SD @ 32/48 [1]. Also: Audience recording using Schoeps CCM 41V and CCM 41 mics, through Lemo cables into a MixPre 6, recorded to SD at 32/48; Edited in Sound Forge Pro 18, converted to FLAC with Traders Little Helper, and tagged in Foobar2000 [1]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillySMVPAlbanyNY2025**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Nakamichi 701's > Gakables > Lunatec V3 > Sound Devices 722 > CF @ 24/96 [2]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyMVPAlbany2025**: taped by Keith Simmons; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Neumann KM 184's > Gakables > Sound Devices 722 > CF @ 24/96 [3]. Also: Edited in Sound Forge Pro 18, converted to FLAC via Traders Little Helper, and tagged in Foobar2000 [3]
- **billystrings2025-11-12.BillyMVP2025**: taped by Keith Simmons; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > DPA 4017's > Gakables > Sound Devices 722 > CF @ 24/96 [4]. Also: Edited in Sound Forge Pro 18, converted to FLAC via Traders Little Helper, and tagged in Foobar2000 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings MVP Arena 2025 – Poster Regular - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/mvp-arena-2025-poster-regular/) [8]
- Poster by BerryLittles: [Official Poster Billy Strings November 12 2025 MVP Arena In Albany, NY t-shirt, hoodie, sweater, long sleeve and tank to](https://berrylittles.com/product/official-poster-billy-strings-november-12-2025-mvp-arena-in-albany-ny-t-shirt/) [9]
- Poster by Blaxteeco: [Billy Strings Albany New York 2025 Event Poster At MVP Arena On November 12 2025 Home Decor Poster Canvas - Blaxteeco](https://blaxteeco.com/product/billy-strings-albany-new-york-2025-event-poster-at-mvp-arena-on-november-12-2025-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [10]
